phase: S2 development validation before acceptance or S3
decode: Sequential from frame zero; no random seek or future frames
preprocess: Decoded BGR to RGB, PIL bilinear resize256 with same normalization as NativeValidationDataset; verify decoded keyframe RGB hashes against frozen29 before comparing precision
native_output: Per-expert softmax FP32 bilinear align_corners=False before argmax; frozen A0-fiber-priority rule, no thresholds/morphology/history
shared_forward: Reuse same three forwards to export all references; classwise timing includes every network and fusion. No joint521 fourth model is required for full replay; retain its29-frame result
repeat_check: Identical-frame outputs repeat exactly; evaluation mode, no gradients or parameter updates
exports: Native masks for all three references, per-frame JSONL diagnostics, full comparison previews and fixed user-event clips; no huge full-video probability dump required
diagnostics_fixed_before_replay: Native predicted stone/fiber area and estimated-FOV area fraction
Adjacent uncompensated label-change fraction and absolute class-area change; proxy only, motion/camera/exposure may explain changes
Per-class nonempty-to-empty/empty-to-nonempty transitions and predicted-presence run lengths; no minimum-area tuning, no claim of true disappearance or identity
Large predicted stone region fraction>0.25 of estimated FOV inherited from A0 review proposal, only diagnostic, not a true false positive
Summaries by video and fixed user interval with exact zero-based to one-based mapping
Recompute29 reviewed-frame native metrics and compare batch1 against prior batch2 results; report any preprocessing/numerical differences rather than reselect thresholds
timing: 12-frame warmup excluded; record CUDA-synchronized all3-network inference/native transfer separately from decode/preprocess/render/write/total. Report p50/p95 and elapsed throughput, compare with native source fps; offline writer is not measured live display
limitations: No dense event/instance GT; do not call diagnostic counts FP duration, temporal accuracy, identity retention or occlusion recovery. No calibrated fused probabilities, hidden-stone reconstruction or spatial/laser geometry validation
stop_and_decision: Hash, geometry, frame alignment or repeat-check failure stops acceptance. Preserve outputs; no threshold search, new training, default adoption or automatic S3. Use full replay and existing image132 limitations to decide whether lightweight fiber refinement or further baseline work is needed
constraints: Validation only, no video-derived training/pseudo labels. stone_new banned from training; all checkpoint files and active521/132/144/29 splits unchanged; reserved-test pixels never read
